Garlic Knots Baker's Percentage

Garlic Knots is mixed from 400 g of flour at 64% water, no starter, 2.2% salt, and 0.5% yeast. Tie strips into knots and bake them through before you toss them with oil and garlic.

Percentages are of the flour you weigh out, and effective hydration also counts the flour and water inside a starter that is itself 100% hydration.
